behavior: `Menu.Empty` keeps its element with `role="status"` in the DOM while the popup is open, and adds its content when no item shows. A screen reader reads a live region that is in the DOM before its text changes, and `Combobox.Empty` has the same form. The element with no content matches `:empty`, so a style can hide it. Base UI renders the element only while no item shows, and it changes the text of the element for 200 ms after the mount to make a screen reader read it.
